links.outcome: Detection of performance decline between test and inference data by automated monitoring
links.effect: Performance discrepancies between test and inference data were detected in 8 of 18 models, prompting fine-tuning.
links.quote: Performance discrepancies between test and inference data were detected in 8 of 18 models, prompting fine-tuning workflows that reduced performance gaps.

links.outcome: Recovery of performance metrics after fine-tuning models that had declined
links.effect: With declines of up to 40.6% (cardiomegaly, InceptionV3), fine-tuning restored performance metrics to within 2% of baseline.
links.quote: In cases with declines of up to 40.6% (cardiomegaly dataset, InceptionV3), fine-tuning restored performance metrics to within 2% of baseline values.

unlisted_practices: LLM-based multi-agent system automating performance monitoring and triggering fine-tuning
Parameter-anchoring regularization to limit catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning
Natural language interface for model monitoring

screen.practice: automated drift monitoring with triggered fine-tuning
screen.reason: The study develops and tests an LLM multi-agent framework designed specifically to monitor drift/performance decline and trigger corrective fine-tuning to safeguard medical imaging models.

primary.practice: automated drift monitoring and continuous fine-tuning/recalibration
